drafts.text:
It's not that I forget the rule.
Right now, in the middle of a live trade, the rule just stops existing.
That's the part nobody tells you starting out. Years in this and the market can still talk you out of your own name.
Getting out of your own way isn't a lesson you learn once. It's a fight you have again every single day you sit down in front of the charts.
drafts.why: Turns a real audience comment about live-market hypnosis into the account's proven deep-engagement format. Stakes are identity/time, not money.
drafts.why_es: Convierte un comentario real de la audiencia sobre la hipnosis del mercado en vivo en el formato de más engagement de la cuenta. La apuesta es identidad/tiempo, no dinero.

drafts.text:
In the ten seconds before you break your own rule, something is racing the clock.
Not logic. Need.
The need to be right. The need to escape the pain of being wrong. The need to still feel in control.
Whichever one wins gets there before the rule even has a chance to speak.
drafts.why: Direct build of a real comment into the account's best-reach shape. No question, citable last line, corroborated by this week's wider niche scan.
drafts.why_es: Construcción directa de un comentario real en el formato de mayor alcance de la cuenta. Sin pregunta, última línea citable, respaldado por el scan del nicho de esta semana.

drafts.text:
Don't be like me and turn every gap against you into a referendum on your character.
Sometimes the market isn't testing you. Sometimes there was just a number at 8:30 that had nothing to do with you at all.
I've burned hours "reflecting" on moves that were never personal. That's not discipline. That's ego wearing self-awareness as a costume.
drafts.source: toddc comment on Globex gap post
drafts.why: Fresh format for this batch, turns an overlooked comment into self-accountability that blames overthinking, not the market.
drafts.why_es: Formato nuevo para este batch, convierte un comentario pasado por alto en autorresponsabilidad que culpa al sobrepensar, no al mercado.
